# Project-authored golden pair

These original synthetic v2 and v3 manifests were authored separately for independent acceptance testing. They use reserved example.test hostnames and no external content. Expected invariants: stable manifest ID; three ordered canvas IDs a/b/c; English/French title; repeated Note metadata rows in order; equal image assignments; right-to-left paged presentation; CC BY 4.0 rights assertion. Pages a/c deliberately share a label. No converter or production extractor generated this pair. They are project test code/data under MIT.
